name: Match detail page has a back-to-bracket link
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the page provides a back navigation link targeting the bracket or homepage.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Click the back navigation link on the match detail page
Verify the click navigates away from the match detail page and lands on the bracket homepage or the groups page
